purpose: Exactly two genuinely different, fixed-parameter Binance M5 hypotheses on fresh non-overlapping data. Results are fixed before observation; criteria are never relaxed and no grid search is permitted.

pre_registration_integrity.connectivity_probe_only: A 2-candle public klines probe returned HTTP 200 at approximately 2026-11-28T00:32Z. It was used only to check reachability; no dataset was built, inspected, or used to choose a parameter.

data_plan.admission: BTCUSDT first. ETHUSDT only after BTCUSDT passes provenance and quality gates. Any other asset requires explicit admission plus data-quality checks before use.
quality_gates: checksum SHA-256 recorded in provenance sidecar
stale data rejected relative to retrieval time

shared_features.realized_vol_20: standard deviation of the last 20 log returns
shared_features.vol_percentile_100: percentile rank of realized_vol_20 within the last 100 bars
shared_features.prior_high_24: max(high, 24 bars before entry signal bar)
shared_features.prior_low_24: min(low, 24 bars before entry signal bar)
shared_features.body_range_ratio: abs(close - open) / (high - low), 0 when high == low

hypotheses.hypothesis: After a realized-volatility contraction, a 5-minute breakout confirmed by abnormal volume and a strong candle body has positive out-of-sample expectancy after costs on BTCUSDT M5 spot.
hypotheses.mechanism: Contraction (vol_percentile_100 <= 0.30 at least once in the prior 12 bars) followed by expansion (vol_percentile_100 >= 0.70 now); close breaks prior_high_24; volume_z24 >= 1.5; body_range_ratio >= 0.5.
hypotheses.execution: signal computed from closed bar t-1; entry at open of bar t; stop and TP from ATR14 at entry; one position per signal; exit on stop, TP, expiry or max hold.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A failed downward thrust (close below prior_low_24 with abnormal volume, followed by a close back above that low within two bars) has positive out-of-sample expectancy after costs on BTCUSDT M5 spot. This is a price-action reversal mechanism, distinct from volatility-breakout momentum and from RSI/VWAP mean reversion.
hypotheses.mechanism: Bar t-3 closes below prior_low_24 with volume_z24 >= 1.5; within the next 2 closed bars a close returns above prior_low_24; enter long at the next bar open. Proxy for a liquidity-grab reversal only: no claim about market-maker identity or position.
hypotheses.execution: signal computed only from closed bars; entry at next bar open; one position per signal; exit on stop, TP, expiry or max hold.

evaluation.selection: config and hypothesis selection on validation only, out-of-sample evaluated once
evaluation.decision_rule: A hypothesis is promoted only if it passes every criterion on out-of-sample data AND a majority of walk-forward folds. If both hypotheses fail, record the cause and stop; do not tune parameters, do not rerun a grid, and do not relax criteria.
